theater: 河南三門峽陝城（崤山南麓）

battle.name: 陝城之戰
battle.theater: 河南三門峽陝城（崤山南麓）
battle.brief: 元嘉二十七年（450）十一月，劉宋北伐西路軍連下盧氏、弘農，兵鋒抵北魏洛州陝城。刺史張是連提率眾二萬度崤山來援，薛安都卸甲單騎突陣、柳元怙夜出南門，激戰整日，魏軍大敗，三千餘人被斬、二千餘人被俘，陝城遂陷。斯巴達長矛對應宋軍列陣所用的長槍體系，與方陣中長矛決定站位的作用同構。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 四百五十年的中原，兩個王朝隔著崤山與黃河相持。南面是劉宋，統治者為元嘉二十七年（450）下令北伐的宋文帝劉義隆，中樞在長江下游的建康，軍令自建康發出，糧秣自江淮與河南各郡徵發；北面是北魏，君主為太平真君十一年（450）的太武帝拓跋弘，中樞在平城與洛陽，東線正由皇帝親率大軍南征，直抵瓜步一線。西線的接戰由雙方的地方守將經手：劉宋北伐西路由中兵參軍柳元景、振威將軍尹顯祖、奮武將軍魯方平、建武將軍薛安都、略陽太守龐法起率部推進；北魏方面，弘農郡太守李初古拔固守弘農城，洛州刺史張是連提統率河洛兵馬救援陝城，州兵與郡兵合流成一股。陝城、弘農、盧氏與金門塢一線的據點，是雙方在崤山南北爭奪的關鍵節點：北魏守住它便可屏障洛陽，劉宋取下它便能把戰線推向河北。就體系而言，劉宋此役仍以步軍為骨幹，騎兵居兩翼作機動與追擊；北魏則以突騎作為衝鋒主力，把守城步卒壓在城牆與塢堡之間。
countriesEn: The China of the year 450 was a land of two courts facing each other across the Xiao mountains and the Yellow River. To the south stood the Liu Song, ruled by Emperor Wen, Liu Yilong, who issued the order for the northern expedition in the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia (450). The Song centre of government lay at Jiankang in the lower Yangtze, orders travelled north from there, and grain, cloth and levies were drawn from the provinces of the lower Yangtze and from Henan. To the north stood the Northern Wei, ruled by Emperor Taiwu, Tuoba Hong, in the eleventh year of the Taiping Zhenjun era (450). Its capital remained at Pingcheng, with the operational centre at Luoyang, and in the east the emperor himself was leading a field army south towards the Yangtze, as far as the riverbank at Guabu. On the western front the contact was made by the provincial commanders of both sides: the Song western column was led by the Middle Army staff officer Liu Yuanjing, the Commander of Inspired Might Yin Xianzu, the Commander of Valiant Might Lu Fangping, the Constructor of Martial Might Xue Andu and the Administrator of Lueyang Pang Faqi. For the Wei, the Administrator of Hongnong, Li Chugu, held the walled city of Hongnong, while the Governor of Luozhou, Zhang Shilianti, led the troops of the Luo valley to relieve Shancheng, the state troops and the commandery troops being merged into a single force. The chain of posts at Shancheng, Hongnong, Lushi and Jinmenwu mattered because these were the hinge points of the Xiao mountain corridor: while the Wei held them, Luoyang was screened, and once the Song took them the front could be pushed forward to the Yellow River. In terms of order of battle the Song still rested on infantry, with cavalry on both flanks used for manoeuvre and pursuit, while the Wei put its weight on shock cavalry, keeping the defenders of the walls pinned between the ramparts and the fortified farmsteads.
people: 留下姓名的，多數在宋軍一方。中兵參軍柳元景是此役的總樞：閏十月他隨龐法起、薛安都、魯方平等攻盧氏、弘農，弘農城破後由宋文帝任命他為弘農太守，命其於軍後督糧；陝城攻堅受阻時，又是他把最要緊的一步棋交給旁人——遣副將柳元怙率二千步騎自南門出擊。建武將軍薛安都是全役最耀眼的名字：魏軍突騎衝鋒時，他脫去兜鍪、解下甲衣，又令戰馬卸去具裝，單騎突陣，往來衝殺，殺傷甚眾；日暮魏軍退去時，他與魯方平又當面定下死戰之志。奮武將軍魯方平在弘農城破時自南門入城、生擒郡丞，陝城下則力主與魏軍拼死。略陽太守龐法起、振威將軍尹顯祖各率本部參戰；殿中將軍鄧盛招得宜陽人劉寬虯，率合義徒二千餘人攻下金門塢；薛安都部下譚金、薛系孝登城生擒李初古拔父子；魯元保則自函谷關引兵趕到，解了城下之圍。北魏方面，洛州刺史張是連提是此役的敗將，死於亂軍；弘農太守李初古拔與其子李買得被生擒，李買得是永昌王拓跋仁的長史，勇冠戎類，他一死，拓跋仁如有失左右手。太武帝拓跋弘本人此刻在另一條戰線上南征，遲至瓜步。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive come from the Song side. Liu Yuanjing, a staff officer of the Middle Army, was the hinge of the whole operation. In the intercalary tenth month he moved with Pang Faqi, Xue Andu, Lu Fangping and the rest against Lushi and Hongnong; once Hongnong had fallen the emperor appointed him administrator of Hongnong and ordered him to supervise the commissariat at the rear of the column. When the siege of Shancheng stalled, it was he who entrusted the decisive step to someone else, sending his deputy Liu Yuanhu with two thousand foot and horse out of the south gate. Xue Andu, Constructor of Martial Might, was the most conspicuous figure of the day. When the Wei shock cavalry charged, he stripped off his helmet and armour, ordered his warhorse's caparison removed as well, and rode alone into the enemy line, riding up and down and killing in the mêlée; when the Wei withdrew at dusk, he and Lu Fangping settled between themselves that they would fight to the death. Lu Fangping, Commander of Valiant Might, entered the south gate of Hongnong and took the commandery deputy prisoner, and at Shancheng he was the one who insisted on a fight to the end. The Administrator of Lueyang, Pang Faqi, and the Commander of Inspired Might, Yin Xianzu, each led their own contingent; the Palace Officer Deng Sheng gathered the men of Yiyang, Liu Kuanqiu, and with two thousand and more volunteers took Jinmenwu; two of Xue Andu's men, Tan Jin and Xue Jixiao, climbed the wall and seized Li Chugu and his son alive; and Lu Yuanbao came up from Hangu Pass with reinforcements and relieved the city. On the Wei side the governor of Luozhou, Zhang Shilianti, was the loser of the day and died in the rout; the administrator of Hongnong, Li Chugu, and his son Li Maide were taken alive, and Li Maide, who was a staff officer of Prince Yongchang Tuoba Ren and was said to be the bravest of his company, when he fell left the prince feeling as if he had lost his right hand. Emperor Taiwu himself was on another front that month, campaigning south, and only reached the Guabu bank of the Yangtze later on.
kits: 卡面這件斯巴達長矛是公元前八世紀的產物：兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套，方陣之中，長矛比劍更早決定誰站得住。放到四百五十年的中國戰場上，它對應的正是南北朝軍隊手中的長槍與大槊——以長木為桿、前綴長刃的兵器，也是劉宋步軍在列陣時的基本裝備。史載此役兩軍相持最烈之處，正是宋軍步騎在城南與城西南列陣、與魏軍突騎貼身纏鬥的場面：步卒結長兵之陣，騎兵在兩翼掩護並伺隙衝擊，與斯巴達方陣以矛代劍的功能位置如出一轍。魏軍一方的重點在騎兵：張是連提所部突騎以衝鋒打散宋軍陣腳，薛安都因此卸去兜鍪與甲衣、命坐騎脫去具裝，以一身輕裝投入死鬥，可見南北朝重甲騎與輕裝突騎在實戰中的分野。除長兵之外，兩軍尚有弓弩、盾與護體甲胄，遠道而來的魏軍倚賴騎兵攜帶的戰馬與自備乾糧，宋軍則靠柳元景在軍後督糧的糧道維持；守城一端，弘農、陝城與金門塢本身就是工事，塢牆、缺口、城門與城樓才是爭奪的重點所在。
kitsEn: The dory on the card is an artefact of the eighth century before the common era: a wooden shaft two metres long with a bronze cap on the butt, and in the phalanx it was the spear, not the sword, that first decided who would keep their footing. Set against a Chinese battlefield of the year 450, its counterpart is the long spear and the great spear of the Southern and Northern Dynasties, weapons with a long wooden shaft and a long blade fixed at the head, and the basic arm of the Song infantry when they closed ranks. The passages that describe the fiercest moments of this campaign show Song infantry and horse drawn up in array on the south and the southwest of the city, locked in close combat with the Wei shock cavalry: the foot stood in a line of long weapons while the horse covered the flanks and waited for the gaps to open, exactly the functional role the long spear played in the Spartan phalanx. On the Wei side the weight of the army lay with its cavalry, and the mounted shock troops of Zhang Shilianti broke the Song formation by charge, which is why Xue Andu stripped off his helmet and armour and had his horse's caparison taken off as well, going into a death struggle in light equipment; the difference between the heavily protected Northern and Southern Dynasties horse and the light shock rider is plain in that scene. Besides the long weapons both armies had bows and crossbows, shields and body armour; the Wei, coming a long way, relied on the horses and the self-carried rations of their riders, while the Song depended on the grain route that Liu Yuanjing supervised at the rear of the column. On the defensive side the works were the fortifications themselves, and the walls of Hongnong, Shancheng and the ramparts of Jinmenwu, their breaches, gates and gate towers were what the fighting was actually about.
tactics: 整場戰役由三段動作接成。第一段是硬攻：盧氏既下，諸軍鼓噪進攻弘農，李初古拔父子據南門督戰，薛安都部將譚金、薛系孝率兵攀上城頭，把守將父子生擒，魯方平自南門入城，生擒郡丞；另一支由鄧盛招集的合義徒攻克金門塢，斬金門戍主與永昌王拓跋仁的長史李買得，拔掉魏軍在弘農的一處外圍支點。第二段是攻堅受阻與援軍到來：宋軍進抵陝城，因地勢險固一時難克，柳元景受命為弘農太守、於軍後督糧，攻城方略轉為持久；北魏洛州刺史張是連提率眾二萬度崤山來援，在城南列陣，以突騎衝撞宋軍，宋軍一時難以抵擋，薛安都單騎突陣、殺傷甚眾，日暮時魯元保自函谷關引兵趕到，魏兵乃退。第三段最關鍵：當夜柳元景遣副將柳元怙率二千步騎自南門出，魏軍尚未發覺；次日薛安都等在城西南列陣，魯方平與薛安都先定死戰之志，柳元怙自南門突出，魏軍無備驚駭不已，宋軍奮進，激戰整日，魏軍大敗。整體看，這是一套攻城、外援、夜襲、合戰的序列：步槍陣與騎兵機動互相牽制，勝敗不取決於正面硬撼，而取決於援軍到場的時點與夜襲的突然性。
tacticsEn: The campaign was built out of three consecutive movements. The first was the frontal assault. With Lushi taken, the columns rushed Hongnong with shouts; Li Chugu and his son held the south gate and supervised the defence, Tan Jin and Xue Jixiao of Xue Andu's command climbed the rampart and took the garrison commander and his son alive, Lu Fangping entered by the south gate and seized the commandery deputy, and another body, the volunteers gathered by Deng Sheng, took Jinmenwu and killed its commandant together with Li Maide, the staff officer of Prince Yongchang Tuoba Ren, removing one of the Wei outposts around Hongnong. The second movement was the stalled assault and the arrival of relief. The Song advanced to Shancheng and could not take it at once because the ground was steep and hard; Liu Yuanjing was appointed administrator of Hongnong and put in charge of the commissariat at the rear, and the siege settled into a waiting game. The governor of Luozhou, Zhang Shilianti, came over the Xiao mountains with twenty thousand men, drew them up on the south of the city and charged the Song line with his shock cavalry; the Song could not stand the impact, Xue Andu rode alone into the enemy and killed in the mêlée, and when Lu Yuanbao arrived from Hangu Pass at dusk the Wei withdrew. The third movement was the decisive one. That night Liu Yuanjing sent his deputy Liu Yuanhu out of the south gate with two thousand foot and horse, and the Wei had not yet noticed. On the following day Xue Andu and the others were drawn up on the southwest of the city, Lu Fangping and Xue Andu first made their resolve to fight to the death explicit, Liu Yuanhu burst out of the south gate into a Wei army taken by surprise, the Song pressed forward, and after a day of hard fighting the Wei were routed. In the round the sequence was assault, relief, night attack and general engagement: the spear line and the cavalry manoeuvre held each other in check, and the outcome turned not on the weight of the frontal clash but on the moment the relieving force arrived and on how sudden the night attack was.
data: 有根據可查的數字大致如下。北魏援軍的規模，史料記為眾二萬；宋軍方面有兩處明確人數，一為柳元怙所領的步騎二千，一為劉寬虯率領的合義徒二千餘人；弘農城內守軍則記為三千餘人。戰果方面，魏軍被斬者三千餘人，張是連提與將卒俱在其中；赴河溺死者甚眾，被俘者二千餘人，俘虜其後由柳元景一律釋放遣回。另有三處時間標記可用：北伐命令下於七月，先後攻略盧氏與弘農在閏十月，陝城合戰在十一月，其時太武帝主力已南下至瓜步一線。就距離而言，弘農與函谷關一帶（今靈寶東北）至陝城（今三門峽市西）按今公路約六十餘公里，盧氏至弘農約一百公里，道路皆在崤山南北的谷道之間，山道折轉，騎兵一日可至，魏軍援兵之所以能在一夜之間壓到城下，正出於此。
dataEn: The figures that can be supported run roughly as follows. The Wei relief force is recorded as twenty thousand men. On the Song side two numbers are explicit, the two thousand foot and horse under Liu Yuanhu and the two thousand and more volunteers under Liu Kuanqiu; the garrison inside Hongnong is put at more than three thousand men. As for the result, the Wei lost more than three thousand killed, Zhang Shilianti and his officers among them, a great many drowned in the river, and more than two thousand were taken prisoner, after which Liu Yuanjing released them all and sent them back. Three time markers are available as well: the order for the expedition was issued in the seventh month, Lushi and Hongnong fell in the intercalary tenth month, and the engagement at Shancheng was fought in the eleventh, by which time Taiwu's main army had already moved south to the Guabu bank. As for distances, from Hongnong and the Hangu Pass area, now to the north-east of Lingbao, to Shancheng, now west of Sanmenxia, is about sixty and some kilometres by present road, and from Lushi to Hongnong about a hundred; both roads run through the valleys north and south of the Xiao mountains, where the track doubles back on itself and a horseman can cover the ground in a day, which is exactly why the Wei relief reached the walls within a single night.
cause: 打起來有兩層原因。表層是北魏的連年南侵：自太平真君年間起，魏軍不斷越過黃河、淮水剽掠劉宋州郡，邊郡破壞而防務空虛，宋廷每次都要重建城壘、重新議守，朝中主戰一派則認為一味退守只會讓對方把戰線推得更近。深層是宋文帝的北伐執念：劉義隆自元嘉即位便以北伐中原為志，此時魏軍主力被皇帝帶往長江，西線空虛，而崤山南北正是北魏與劉宋的接合處，若自西路出奇制勝、斷魏軍後路，便可直叩洛陽。宋軍因此於七月出兵：西路由柳元景等率眾自盧氏、弘農一線推進，中路大軍指向滑台，取弘農、陝城正是為了與中路形成呼應、為中原之役做側翼。正因為這是一場主動出擊而不是被迫應戰，攻城與打援才會咬得如此緊密，勝敗也才會繫於每一個時點。
causeEn: There were two layers behind the fighting. On the surface lay the Wei invasions of the south, which had continued year on year since the Taiping Zhenjun era: Wei forces repeatedly crossed the Yellow and Huai rivers to strip the Song prefectures, frontier commanderies were ruined and the defence went hollow, the Song court had to rebuild its walls and argue about how to hold them afresh, and the war party at court held that a purely defensive posture would only let the enemy push the front further forward. Deeper down lay Emperor Wen's determination on the northern expedition. Since taking the throne in the Yuanjia era Liu Yilong had made the recovery of the Central Plain his purpose, and with the main Wei army drawn off to the Yangtze the west was thin; the two states met at the Xiao mountains, and a thrust along the western flank that surprised the enemy and cut the Wei supply could have carried straight to Luoyang. The Song therefore took the field in the seventh month, with Liu Yuanjing and the others advancing along the Lushi and Hongnong line in the west while the main body in the centre aimed at Suan, taking Hongnong and Shancheng in order to work in concert with the central column and to cover the flank of the Central Plain campaign. Because this was an offensive of their own choosing rather than a defensive response, the assault and the relief fighting interlaced so closely, and the outcome came to hang on every moment of the sequence.
impact: 就眼前看，陝城之役是元嘉北伐中乾淨的一場：弘農、陝城相繼落入宋軍之手，魏軍在崤山南麓的支點被拔除，消息傳到洛陽與平城，河北方向的安全感為之一空。然而整體戰局卻在同時崩塌：同年冬天，主攻滑台的一路在糧道被斷、退路受阻的情況下全軍潰散，主將以自毀之罪被殺，北伐的聲勢一落千丈。陝城的勝利於是成一場沒有後續的勝利——得城之後，糧道仍自南方運來，援軍仍自函谷關與盧氏方向接續，但朝廷已無力氣把戰線推過崤山。制度層面的代價更重：元嘉二十七年是劉宋財政與民力被北伐抽乾的一年，江南的租調與丁役大量投入北方戰事而所得有限；同年宋文帝劉義隆因子劉劭的陰謀被弒，改元在即的元嘉末年隨之而來。北魏一方因拓跋弘南征逼近江淮，一時無力反攻西線，陝城遂成雙方默契中的停手處；魏人在河南的統治反而藉此收束到洛陽一線，崤山南北重新變成一條只有守禦而沒有反攻的界線。
impactEn: On the face of it, Shancheng was the one clean success of the Yuanjia northern expeditions: Hongnong and Shancheng fell in turn to the Song, the Wei foothold south of the Xiao mountains was torn out, and the news reaching Luoyang and Pingcheng emptied the north of its sense of security. Yet the campaign as a whole was collapsing at the same moment. In the winter of the same year the column that had aimed at Suan broke up completely when its grain route was cut and its line of withdrawal closed, and its commander was executed on the charge of destroying his own army; the momentum of the northern expeditions drained away. The victory at Shancheng therefore became a victory without a sequel: with the city taken, the grain still had to come from the south and the reinforcements still came in through Hangu Pass and from Lushi, but the court had no strength left to carry the front across the Xiao mountains. The institutional cost was heavier still. The twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia was the year in which the finances and the manpower of the Liu Song were drained by the expeditions, with the rents, taxes and corvée of the south thrown into a northern war that returned little; in the same year Emperor Wen Liu Yilong was murdered in a plot by his son Liu Shao, and the tumult of the last years of Yuanjia followed hard upon it. For the Wei, with Tuoba Hong's southern campaign pressing towards the Yangtze, there was no strength to counterattack in the west, and Shancheng became a place where both sides tacitly stopped. Wei rule in Henan tightened instead around Luoyang, and the line through the Xiao mountains became a frontier held rather than one crossed.
result: 結局是宋軍取城，魏軍敗散。十一月，張是連提所部在城西南被擊潰，主將與將卒三千餘人被斬，許多人赴河溺死，又有二千餘人成為俘虜；柳元景照例放走俘虜遣回，換回的是一段暫時的安靜。弘農、陝城歸宋，北魏在崤山南麓的前哨退守河南，拓跋仁喪失長史李買得，李初古拔父子被擒，直到次年太武帝南征至長江時，李初古拔才被放回北魏。宋軍這邊，西路軍由柳元景接任弘農太守，坐鎮新附之地主持籌糧與屯守；宋人在弘農與陝城取得的短暫據點，隨著滑台的敗績與元嘉政局的崩潰而被逐步放棄，陝城重回北魏之手，隸屬的弘農郡與陝郡此後成為北魏經營河南、遏制關中的前哨。那把兩米長的長矛留在正史的幾行記載裡：一面是薛安都卸去兜鍪與具裝、單騎入陣的背影，另一面是柳元怙夜出南門時身後的兩千步騎。
resultEn: The Song took the city and the Wei broke. In the eleventh month Zhang Shilianti's army was shattered on the southwest of the city: the commander and more than three thousand of his men were killed, a great many drowned in the river, and more than two thousand were taken prisoner; Liu Yuanjing released the prisoners and sent them home, as was his way, and what he bought with it was a spell of quiet. Hongnong and Shancheng passed to the Song, the Wei outposts south of the Xiao mountains withdrew to Henan, Prince Yongchang Tuoba Ren lost his staff officer Li Maide, and Li Chugu and his son, held captive, were not returned to the Wei until the following year, when Taiwu campaigned south as far as the Yangtze. On the Song side the western column had Liu Yuanjing take up the post of administrator of Hongnong, to sit in the newly taken country and direct the grain and the garrisons. The foothold the Song had gained at Hongnong and Shancheng was gradually given up as the defeat at Suan and the collapse of the Yuanjia government followed, and Shancheng returned to the Wei, while the Hongnong and Sha commanderies became the outposts by which the Northern Wei organised Henan and contained the Guanzhong region. The two-metre spear survives in the histories only in a few lines: one is the sight of Xue Andu, helmet and caparison cast off, riding alone into the line, and the other is the two thousand foot and horse behind Liu Yuanhu as he came out of the south gate in the dark.
